name: Camp Tevya
description_short: A co-ed Jewish overnight camp on Lake Potanipo in Brookline, New Hampshire, running since 1940. It offers 3.5-week and 7-week sessions, plus short first-timer sessions of 1 and 2 weeks, with Jewish life, waterfront, sports and arts activities.
swim_waterfront_notes: The camp is on Lake Potanipo, and campers swim and paddle there. The page gives no details on swim instruction, testing or lifeguarding.

source.title: Summer Camps Near Me | Explore Outdoors & Judaism at Camp Tevya

warnings: This is the camp's own homepage. Session dates and tuition are on a separate page that was not provided (https://www.cohencamps.org/tevya/summer/dates-tuition/).

The page says opening day is Wednesday, June 23, 2027, and counts down 253 days, which matches today's date. It does not say which session or sessions start that day, so no session start dates were recorded.
Two phone numbers are listed: summer 603.673.4010 and year-round 781.489.2070. The year-round office is at 888 Worcester Street, Suite 350, Wellesley, MA 02482.
